<a id="architecture"></a>

## Architecture

Doctrine: .agents/skills/pij-team/TENETS.md (tenets 1-6); repo instantiation per docs/rules-idioms-architecture/fs3-architecture.md (binding). THE INVARIANT ABOVE ALL: the frozen JSON envelope is the product's agent contract — rendering is a PRESENTATION layer added AFTER envelope production, never a change to it (ac-0002 byte-goldens enforce this mechanically). Placement: output-mode decision fn in CORE (pure); the Renderer seam + human renderers in CLI (crates/cli — presentation is shell, and the render path may depend on ratatui-adjacent crates the daemon must never carry); event emission in DAEMON at work-completion points, served via the existing daemon HTTP surface as an NDJSON stream endpoint the CLI consumes for --watch and tui; the tui verb in CLI. Allow-list grants: cli -> ratatui + crossterm (two rows); cli -> the render support crates the POC's LEARNINGS justify (each a named row, PM-granted at phase 1 from the LEARNINGS list, not improvised); NO new daemon dependencies (the stream uses what the daemon already serves HTTP with). INTERFACES SETTLED PHASE 1: output-mode fn signature + precedence table; Renderer trait; --watch NDJSON wire types (versioned). Authoritative inputs: pocs/human-render/LEARNINGS.md (promotion shape — the POC already named it), scratch/tui-poc/VERDICT.md (vendor into assets/inputs/ — scratch is gitignored, refs must resolve where seats live), DL-045 (the mocked-feed gap). Jordan rulings 2026-08-28 verbatim: default human output with --json available; TUI POC verdict accepted, React deferred.

| rationale | Three genuinely independent units behind phase-1 seams: u-r (CLI render), u-w (daemon stream), u-t (tui verb). Zero shared files: u-r owns the render module + per-verb renderers, u-w owns daemon event emission + the stream endpoint, u-t owns the tui module; each exports through its own one-line hook. u-t consumes u-w's WIRE TYPES (frozen phase 1), not its implementation — it builds against a recorded NDJSON fixture until composition, so all three run wave 1 in parallel. Phase 1 solo-PM; phase 3 PM composes. |
